verdict.rationale: Edge0 documents that LoRA adapters stay unmerged, so one read-only base serves multiple adapter sets. Upgrading swaps only the adapter files, and there is an OpenAI-compatible `edge0 serve` endpoint plus a `--no-lora` toggle. However, the evidence is a single-line claim, and the adapters shown are Edge0's own quantization-recovery LoRAs bundled per model rather than arbitrary user adapters. Nothing shows how multiple adapters are selected or served at runtime. Missing for 10: per-request or concurrent adapter selection in the server, runtime hot-swap or loading of custom adapters, efficiency or benchmark evidence for multi-adapter serving, independent corroboration.
